name: Rsdp Post And Page Sellings Woocommerce, Post Sell, Page Sell, Post/page Sell
author: rsdp

sections.description:
The WooCommerce Content Locker for Posts and Pages plugin allows site owners to sell individual WordPress posts and pages using WooCommerce. When this plugin is activated, users can set a price for individual posts and pages and restrict access to them until the content has been purchased. This plugin is ideal for monetizing exclusive content on a per-page or per-post basis.

Donate Now

please contact 8115530063

Key Features

Enable sales and set prices on a per-post/page basis.
Restrict content from being viewed until it’s purchased.
Automatically creates WooCommerce products for each purchasable post or page.
Adds custom tabs in the WooCommerce “My Account” page to list purchased posts and pages.
Compatible with any WooCommerce-supported payment gateway.
sections.installation:
Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rsdp-post-and-page-sellings directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
Flush Permalinks: Go to Settings > Permalinks and click “Save Changes” to ensure rewrite rules are applied.
Usage
Set Price and Enable Selling:

Go to any post or page you wish to sell.
In the meta box labeled “Page/Post Sale Settings,” check “Enable Selling” and set a price.
Update or publish the post/page.
Purchase Requirement for Viewing Content:

The content of any post/page marked as for sale will be restricted. Users will need to purchase the content to view it.
View Purchased Content:

Once purchased, customers can go to their My Account page, where new tabs named Purchased Posts and Purchased Pages will show their purchased content.
Screenshots
Meta Box: Enable sales and set a price in the post/page editor.
Purchase Restriction: Content is locked until the user makes a purchase.
My Account – Purchased Posts/Pages: Purchased posts/pages listed under My Account.
sections.faq:
How do I enable a post or page for sale?
Edit the desired post or page. In the “Page/Post Sale Settings” meta box on the right, check “Enable Selling” and enter a price. Save the post/page.

How do customers access purchased content?
Customers can access purchased content via the Purchased Posts and Purchased Pages tabs in the WooCommerce My Account section.

Can I change the price of a post/page after it’s published?
Yes, you can update the price in the meta box of the post/page editor. Note that this will only affect new purchases.
